_doc: Model schema of the Dawnforge Playground. What the keys mean: see the top of playground_models.py. Edit and reload the page, no restart. Native resolutions only: upscaling is a separate job on a finished clip (Upscale in the clip player). The values behind each entry are in engine/jobs.py.

models.label: LTX 2.3 dev Q6
models.note: Measured at 8 steps, 720p: 3 s ≈ 3:30, 10 s ≈ 6:10; 1080p: 3 s ≈ 5:40, 10 s ≈ 13 min. 8 is the fast distilled path. Above 8 it switches to the dev schedule with real guidance (for LoRAs that want more steps): each step costs about 3× as much, not measured yet.

stages.label: Refine
stages.hint: automatic, after the ×2 latent upscale to the render size

models.label: H3 HyperFlow Flash
models.note: Best faces and staging. Measured at 4 steps, 720p: 3 s ≈ 4 min, 4.5 s ≈ 6:30, 8 s ≈ 22 min. 1080p is about 9 min per step.
